# goslop text fixture — exception recorded into error result (calgebra/logxide FP)
lang: python
file: handled_error_result.py
---
def _error_result(exc):
    return {"success": False, "error": exc}

def write_event(payload):
    try:
        return do_write(payload)
    except Exception as e:
        return _error_result(e)
